title: 第23章 难道发现了什么第24章 两份天水精华
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
精致如画的俏脸，乌黑如墨的秀发，虽然已经没有了处子幽香，却有一种其它的香气，也是属于体香的一种。
即使闭着眼睛，那股楚楚动人的风情也是迎面而来，让人有种好好疼爱的冲动。
好在她并没有背叛夏无恙，只是无意中发现了夏无恙的异常，否则的话还真不好处理。
摄魂术无声无息使出，映入怜星的脑海中，开始小心地修改她的记忆，让她忘掉一些不该知道的东西。
为了避免给怜星带来伤害，夏无恙的动作很慢，尽可能地小心一些，足足花费了半个多时辰，这才删改完成，让怜星不会再产生怀疑，以后好好地伺候他。
从怜星这里，夏无恙也知道了一些东宫的秘密，其中还有几个疑似暗谍和内应之人。
“倒是意外之喜……”
处理完成以后，看着仍旧陷入熟睡的佳人们，伸手摸了摸，这才无声无息进入练功室，再次开始修行。
功法、战技、秘术……有条不紊地修行着，一个都未曾放过，不过耗费时间和精力最多的还是功法，战技和秘术其次。
有着超高的悟性，再加上充足的丹药辅助，即使没有奇宝，夏无恙的修行速度仍旧很快。
不过目前最重要的事情还是巩固和适应，将根基打磨圆润，等到剩余的天水精华到手，就可以继续服用天水精华，让修为境界再次飙飞猛进。
下一份天水精华，少说能够将他的修为提升到五品圆满，甚至有可能冲击四品之境。
短短一个多月提升如此之快，若是不将根基打磨圆润的话，定然会影响他以后的修行。
一夜苦修，接近凌晨的时候，再次回到寝殿中，陪着各位绝色来了一场晨运，这才继续今日花天酒地的生活。
看似沉醉不知归路，其实暗中还在不断苦修，综合实力正在迅速提升。
心灵力场更是时刻开启，一旦发现异常，便会第一时间做出应对。
随着精神力量每天增加一点，心灵力场的范围也在不断扩张，能够探测到越来越远的距离，发现一些隐藏的秘密和敌人。
等到有朝一日能够覆盖东宫，甚至是整个皇宫的时候，这里对他来说将会再无秘密，一切都在掌握之中。
而且心灵力场属于天赋，并不是什么战技秘术，隐匿至极，无声无息，即便是修为境界远超夏无恙的人，也很难发现心灵力场的探查。
除非是超越天人层次的存在，后续还有一定可能发现，不过偌大的大夏皇朝，能够超越天人的，似乎只有一位而已。

苦修不辍，很快再次来到夜晚，就在夏无恙弄睡了数名宫女，准备进入练功室的时候，通过心灵力场察觉到了异常。
再次回到锦榻，凝神聚气，等待着不速之客的到来。
月光如水，洒在文华殿的琉璃瓦上，给整个文华殿镀上了一层冷冽的银辉。
夜色深沉，除了偶尔有巡逻侍卫的脚步声，偌大的文华殿内外一片寂静。
一道黑影无声无息地出现在文华殿上方，轻若鸿毛地掠入文华殿中。
content_en:
The delicate and picturesque face, the jet-black hair, although there is no longer the fragrance of virginity, there is another kind of fragrance, which is also a kind of body fragrance.
Even with her eyes closed, that lovely and charming charm is coming towards her, making her feel the urge to love her.
Fortunately, she did not betray Xia Wuchang, but accidentally discovered Xia Wuchang's abnormality, otherwise it would be really difficult to deal with it.
The soul-obsessing technique was used silently, reflected in Ling Xing's mind, and began to carefully modify her memory to make her forget some things she shouldn't know.
In order to avoid causing harm to Lianxing, Xia Wuyang moved very slowly and as carefully as possible. It took him more than half an hour to complete the deletion, so that Lianxing would no longer be suspicious and serve him well in the future.
From Lian Xing, Xia Wuyang also learned some secrets of the East Palace, including several suspected secret spies and insiders.
"It's an unexpected surprise..."
After the processing was completed, he looked at the beauties who were still sleeping soundly, reached out to touch them, and then silently entered the practice room and started practicing again.
Cultivation techniques, combat techniques, secret techniques... they were practiced in an orderly manner, and none of them were spared. However, it was the techniques that consumed the most time and energy, followed by combat techniques and secret techniques.
With his super high understanding and sufficient aid from elixirs, Xia Wuhuang's cultivation speed was still very fast even without Qibao.
However, the most important thing at the moment is to consolidate and adapt, to polish and round the foundation. When the remaining Tianshui essence is obtained, you can continue to take the Tianshui essence to make your cultivation realm soar again.
The next Tianshui Essence, at least, can raise his cultivation level to the fifth level of perfection, and may even reach the fourth level.
He has improved so quickly in just over a month. If the foundation is not polished and rounded, it will definitely affect his future practice.
After a night of hard training, I returned to the dormitory again in the early morning and accompanied all the stunning ladies for a morning exercise before continuing today's life of fun and debauchery.
It seems that he is intoxicated and knows no way back, but in fact he is still practicing hard in secret, and his overall strength is rapidly improving.
The psychic force field is always on, and once an abnormality is discovered, it will respond immediately.
As the mental power increases a little every day, the range of the mental force field is also constantly expanding, able to detect farther and farther distances and discover some hidden secrets and enemies.
When one day he can cover the East Palace, or even the entire palace, there will be no secrets for him here, and everything will be under control.
Moreover, the psychic force field is a talent, not a secret combat technique. It is extremely hidden and silent. Even people whose cultivation level far exceeds Xia Wuyan's, it is difficult to detect the detection of the psychic force field.
Unless it is an existence that transcends the level of heaven and man, it is possible to discover it in the future. However, in the huge Daxia Dynasty, it seems that there is only one person who can surpass the level of heaven and man.
After practicing hard, it soon came to night again. Just as Xia Wuyang slept with several palace maids and was about to enter the practice room, he noticed an abnormality through his spiritual force field.
Returning to the brocade couch again, he concentrated his energy and waited for the arrival of the uninvited guests.
The moonlight is like water, shining on the glazed tiles of Wenhua Hall, giving the entire Wenhua Hall a cold silver glow.
The night was dark, except for the occasional footsteps of patrolling guards, there was silence inside and outside the huge Wenhua Hall.
A black shadow appeared silently above the Wenhua Palace and swept into the Wenhua Palace as lightly as a feather.
